name: Hugo Larsen
headline: Analytics and Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer and analytics engineer with a track record of building dependable data pipelines, improving warehouse structures, and turning raw data into usable reporting layers. Comfortable working across ETL, orchestration, and data modeling to support faster decisions and cleaner handoffs between teams.

roles.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built ETL pipelines in Python and SQL to move operational data into PostgreSQL, reducing manual processing by 70%.
Implemented transformation logic in Scala and SQL so recurring datasets were standardized for reporting and analysis.
Improved data quality checks across the ETL flow, cutting load failures from 12 per month to 3.
Collaborated with product and operations teams to clarify source data definitions and keep the backend feed consistent.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Designed Data modeling layers for analytics datasets in BigQuery using SQL and Python, improving metric consistency across 8 dashboards.
Automated Airflow workflows with Bash and Python to coordinate daily loads and refreshes without manual intervention.
Reviewed and versioned pipeline changes with Git and Scala, helping the team ship 30% faster releases to production datasets.
Partnered with stakeholders to refine SQL logic and warehouse structures so reporting cycles finished 2 hours earlier.
Monitored job runs and resolved data issues across Airflow and BigQuery, maintaining stable delivery for business users.

projects.name: Quiet Tracker
projects.description: Built an ETL pipeline to collect, clean, and reshape event data for a lightweight tracking product.
